mapper.insert: INSERT INTO caishen_fund_nav (fund_code, nav_date, unit_nav, accumulated_nav, daily_return_rate, source) VALUES (#{fundCode}, #{navDate}, #{unitNav}, #{accumulatedNav}, #{dailyReturnRate}, #{source}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE unit_nav = new.unit_nav, accumulated_nav = new.accumulated_nav, daily_return_rate = new.daily_return_rate, source = new.source
